The proof applies the weighted entropy comparison for Borel-computing trees (D66F) to the stopped tree, which computes the event by PWBU and has revealment cost bounded by DCRV.

The proof inserts the truncated-mean bound into the cluster-tail differential inequality (JM30) and integrates with an integrating factor.

The proof writes the derivative as the covariance with the exploration score of the stopped tree (PWBU), uses the conditional Bernoulli law of each queried edge (GSLG) and the weighted revealment bound (DCRV), then exhausts the edges.
The proof takes the upper bound from the tree-graph moment bound (Y84V) and squares the derivative bound of UTUF.
The proof inserts the susceptibility bound into the cluster-tail differential inequality (JM30) and integrates from beta to b.
The proof applies the entropy comparison (JL1S) between b-epsilon and b at n of order epsilon^{-2}.
The proof sums the tail derivative inequality (JM30) over n and uses finiteness of the second moment from the tree-graph bound (Y84V).

The proof builds the exploration martingale, checks its conditional law and variance directly, and applies the damped martingale maximum bound (4GBV).
The proof chooses orbit-supported test weights and uses Cauchy-Schwarz; the mention of KDN9 only checks admissibility of the weights.
